notToBeConfusedWith.name: Cassia
notToBeConfusedWith.note: The bark most cinnamon sold outside specialist shops actually is: darker, harder and hotter than Ceylon cinnamon, and rolled in one thick layer rather than many thin ones.

forms.label: Stick
forms.sourceNote: Spices, cinnamon, ground. Public domain; the bark and the ground spice are the same material. No density is carried: the bark is strained out of everything it is used in, so it displaces nothing in the finished drink, and the record's own figure is a teaspoon of powder.
